title: Tazkiyat al-Akhlaq: al-Sidq, al-Rahmah, wa-l-Mas'uliyah (7-9 Years)
description: A path to assist parents in the tarbiyah of their child’s practical akhlaq: sidq (truthfulness), rahmah (compassion) toward siblings and people, amanah (trustworthiness) and responsibility, and controlling anger upon the guidance of the Prophet ﷺ.
